::: {.intro-text}
I'm a computer scientist working on distributed systems and software. I'm interested in how systems behave when they get large, when things fail, and when the elegant idea meets the implementation.

This is where I work through questions in public: peer-to-peer networks, algorithms, statistics, and the occasional detour into programming languages. I learn by building things, taking them apart, and writing down what finally makes sense.

[GitHub](https://github.com/gmega) · [Email](mailto:giuliano.mega@gmail.com) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/giuliano-mega-0433249b)
:::
